summary: CI only: the main-branch native publication step verified its own upload with an unauthenticated recursive path-info query against the private cache, which returned HTTP 401 once the cache stopped serving anonymous reads. The verification now authenticates with the same cache-scoped write token through a job-temporary, owner-only netrc containing only the named cache host; only that explicit remote-store command receives the netrc path and an exit trap removes the file on success or failure.
